validation.notes: Seven scenarios pass against the repaired sources and load the real modules packages/coding-agent/src/utils/text.ts, packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts and packages/coding-agent/src/core/auth-storage.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs (createGraph with an explicit entry list so ./utils/text.ts links to the real utility; config paths, chalk, keybindings and auth-resolution helpers plus proper-lockfile are caller-supplied boundary fakes, fs/path are real for temporary inputs under .prale-eval/.regression-work, cleaned up on exit). Covered cross-module behavior: BOM-encoded oauth.json plus BOM-encoded settings.json#apiKeys migrate with OAuth winning over the same-provider API key, providers reported once, interior BOMs inside key material preserved, auth.json written without a BOM, oauth.json archived byte-identically as oauth.json.migrated, unrelated and nested settings retained with apiKeys removed; the migrated auth.json is then read back through the real ReadOnlyAuthStorage with Promise.all to pin async ordering; stripBom removes only one leading BOM while preserving plain, interior-BOM and double-BOM text and BOM-free legacy files still upgrade; malformed oauth.json stays untouched and unarchived while settings keys migrate; malformed settings.json stays untouched while OAuth migrates; unusable legacy data ([1,2,3], bare string) creates no auth.json and leaves both files byte-identical; an existing auth.json blocks all credential migration without rewriting or archiving anything; runMigrations reports migrated providers once. Mutation evidence: restoring utils/text.ts alone to the faulty baseline fails with [] !== ['anthropic','openai','local'] (uncaught assertion) and restoring migrations.ts alone fails with the duplicated provider list, both as assertion failures rather than crashes, and both baselines were reverted afterwards. Limitation: node_modules is intentionally absent (no dependency installation allowed), so the repository's tsgo type check, biome check and vitest suites could not be run locally; this Node-based cross-module validation is the recorded evidence.
